text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, new trainers and veterans alike
have
gathered to listen to each other's
performance
reports. I've learned quite a
lot from the event,
but...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you'll be sharing your
progress in the
next meeting! I'm excited
to see how you've been
doing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do my best to put together an
insightful
presentation...
choice_data_list: (We have to make this a success!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spend the next few days preparing, but
the
information I've gathered seems
nowhere near as
useful as what the
veteran trainers presented.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Are you doing all right? You look
super
worried about something...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you're worried about not doing
well in
your presentation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I've got just the thing that'll
chase all
your worries away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All you gotta do is get started on some

strength training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's start you off with some dumbbell
lifts! Here,
try this twenty-kilogram one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't see how strength training will
help my
presentation, but since she
seems pretty
concerned about me, I
decide to give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I get ready to lift the dumbbell, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Sorry, I should've picked a
lighter weight
to start with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! From what I can tell, your
deltoids still
have massive room for
growth!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's try again, but with five kilograms
this time!
Trust in your delts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the remainder of the day, I focus on
training
my deltoids by pumping the
five-kilo dumbbells.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right! Today, let's move up to
ten-kilogram
weights! Listen, can you
hear your biceps saying,
"We can do
this"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, the weight of my
dumbbells
increases day by day.
choice_data_list: I guess... it does kind of feel that way?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Those pecs are looking good! I think you
can
finally move up to twenty kilos! You
can lift
fifteen kilos no problem
now—you've got this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! All right, go ahead and
lift them
up!
choice_data_list: Yeah, looks like we can do it...!
Yeah, looks like I can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amazingly, the twenty-kilo dumbbells
that didn't
even budge when I tried
lifting them before rise
ever so slightly in
the air!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's right! You really did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing you can't do as long as
you keep
building yourself up diligently!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment she says that, I suddenly
realize that
if I just work on my
performance report slowly and
steadily,
then maybe, just maybe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There it is! You said it!
choice_data_list: I'll take it step by step and work steadily on the presentation prep, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Anything is possible as long as you stick
to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You know, that's why I suggested
working out in
the first place. I was
hoping it'd help you realize
that for
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, best of luck on your
presentation! I'll be
cheering you on!
